entries.source_evidence: V's exact question to the quiet support worker KN-S1 at first staffed Eastwatch-bound lay-by Day279 about10:15AM, after peaceful Elen/Vos paperwork dispute: "What? Are they prisoners who’ve committed crimes? Or are you trying to tell me something else?" User asks a direct assessment of legal detention vs medical abuse, without agreeing to intervene or committing money/time/combat. KN-S1 is one of four EXISTING support workers attached to Station Kestrel, now at yard collecting two empty military transport cases. They answer from strictly limited firsthand knowledge: they do not know proven criminal charges or convictions; some may have originally been prisoners but KN-S1 cannot truthfully certify none committed offenses. They were officially told the facility is a recovery station for soldiers and other patients; their firsthand exposure now includes 11 living people kept there, six awake and able to speak, three so impaired they cannot walk, and two distressed/restrained. KN-S1 personally witnessed procedures continuing despite subjects' nonconsent and pleas to stop; they believe these are involuntary experiments rather than ordinary lawful treatment, without certifying their full legal status, mechanisms, senior perpetrators or the secret Western Program. Cirren independently asks, "Are you saying they're being used for experiments?" KN-S1 affirms that is what they are trying to convey based on what they actually saw. They offer a copied personal duty sheet and a road itinerary as available evidence if V elects to examine them, but no paper/location has yet been physically handed to the party, documents not yet independently verified or transfer authorized by V. KN-S1 seeks safe care/release for patients, not revenge, and has not promised payment, demanded V assist or joined V's caravan. Their reply is a deliberate private discussion out of immediate sergeant's hearing; Sergeant Adren Vos not magically aware. Sella's separate cargo checks may proceed. No V's additional speech, persuasion/insight checks, magical detection, purchases, acceptance, time loss beyond several minutes, combat or resource spend. Prior Day279 public civilian receipt dispute peacefully resolved, civilian fittings remain civilian's and military can collect own two empty cases. V party stats remain V48/48 HP HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 full, Cirren51/51 HP HD6/6 slots all full, Fenar59/59 HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara unharmed, four healthy owned horses/intact coach, purse969gp3sp6cp, rations18 person-days/feed24 animal-days, one unused sealed Pixie Dust, LongRest3/6. Day279 time~10:18, daytime d100FACE90 no random encounter already resolved; no additional roll/night.
